title: Fancy Oaks Everywhere
description: Every (player set-) oak sapling grows into a fancy oak.
body:
Very simple mod to make sure every single player set oak sapling will grow into a beautiful fancy oak tree.

_Have you designed the fancy oak tree yourself?_\
No, it's the vanilla fancy oak tree. I just made sure this is spawned instead of the basic oak tree when planting a sapling.


_Port to version X pls_\
Bro if I can find the time, whatever. This mod was originally for my personal use.


_Can you add..._\
My guy I used claude.ai and chatgpt to create those 3 files needed to make this mod happen, I become depressed when I see the fabric "documentation".
